note: Machine-readable task index. Source of truth for status is the issue's labels; keep both in sync. See docs/briefs/README.md.

tasks.title: Pipeline: script that verifies a task attempt mechanically
tasks.check: bash scripts/pipeline/tests/verify-task.test.sh
tasks.summary: A script that decides an attempt from docs/tasks.json: only allowed paths changed, and the check passes (or, for tests, fails) from a clean worktree.

tasks.title: No-EA-assets guard script
tasks.check: bash scripts/tests/check-no-ea-assets.test.sh && scripts/check-no-ea-assets.sh
tasks.summary: The guard from #2, usable locally now: fails when the tree or a given folder holds game-data file types outside an allowlist.

tasks.title: Launcher: canvas keeps the right mouse button and the keyboard
tasks.check: cd web && npm ci && npx playwright test
tasks.summary: The game uses right-click and the keyboard: the canvas suppresses the context menu and takes focus on Play.

tasks.title: Launcher: show engine failures on the page
tasks.check: cd web && npm ci && npx playwright test
tasks.summary: An abort or a failed start is shown in a visible error box and recorded like the smoke page does; a `module` parameter allows fake engines in tests.

tasks.title: Launcher: detect missing browser features before import
tasks.check: cd web && npm ci && npx playwright test
tasks.summary: Without WebGPU, cross-origin isolation or OPFS the launcher says what is missing and disables import and Play.

tasks.title: Launcher: persistent storage and a quota check before import
tasks.check: cd web && npm ci && npx playwright test
tasks.summary: Ask for persistent storage, show usage, and refuse an import that does not fit instead of failing halfway.

tasks.title: Static site package with isolation headers
tasks.check: cd web && npm ci && npx playwright test
tasks.summary: `npm run package` builds a self-contained static folder (launcher, wrapper, engine, COOP/COEP headers file) with no game data, checked by the guard.

tasks.title: Real data: first run to the main menu and triage
tasks.check: cd web && ZHWP_GAME_DIR=<install> npx playwright test tests/real-data.spec.ts
tasks.summary: Run `web/tests/real-data.spec.ts` on the owner's install; every failure becomes its own issue with a brief. No delegated work.

tasks.title: Real data: a replay plays in the browser with rendering
tasks.summary: Local-only test: a real replay plays in the windowed engine for N seconds with no WebGPU failure and a non-uniform canvas. Spec after the first real run.

tasks.title: Real data: audio in the browser
tasks.summary: Sound and music play after the first user gesture (browser autoplay rules). Spec after the first real run shows what the audio backend does.

tasks.title: Real data: frame-time baseline
tasks.summary: Measure frame times of a real replay in Brave and record them in docs/porting-notes.md, to know whether phase 1 needs performance work.

tasks.title: Smoke page: engine arguments from the URL
tasks.check: cd web && npm ci && npx playwright test
tasks.summary: Repeated `arg` query parameters replace the default `-win`, so harnesses can run `-headless -replay ...`.

tasks.title: Smoke page: record the engine's exit code
tasks.check: cd web && npm ci && npx playwright test
tasks.summary: When the engine exits (headless replay simulation returns 0 or 1), `__zhwpDone` says `exited` with the code.

tasks.title: Put a replay file into the engine's user data before start
tasks.check: cd web && npm ci && npx playwright test
tasks.summary: `addUserFiles` writes given files under the user data folder after IDBFS loads; the smoke page's `replay=<url>` uses it for `Replays/`.

tasks.title: Oracle: compare two CRC logs
tasks.check: node --test scripts/oracle/tests/
tasks.summary: A Node script that reports the first diverging frame between two `ZHWP_CRC` logs.

tasks.title: Engine: print the logic CRC with -crclog
tasks.check: scripts/build-webgpu.sh && cd web && npm ci && ZHWP_GAME_DIR=<install> ZHWP_REPLAY=<file.rep> npx playwright test tests/real-data-crc.spec.ts
tasks.summary: With `-crclog` the engine prints `ZHWP_CRC <frame> <crc>` every time it computes the logic CRC the recorder compares. Verifiable only with real data.

tasks.title: Oracle: run a replay in Brave and write its CRC log
tasks.check: cd web && npm ci && npx playwright test
tasks.summary: `npm run replay -- --replay x.rep --out x.crc` runs the smoke page headless in Brave and saves the `ZHWP_CRC` lines; tested with a fake engine.

tasks.title: Oracle: native replay runner
tasks.summary: `scripts/oracle/run-native.sh` runs the native build of the same commit with `-headless -replay -crclog` and writes the CRC log.

tasks.title: Oracle: one command per replay, native vs browser
tasks.summary: `scripts/oracle/oracle.sh <replay>` runs both, compares, prints the first diverging frame. Local only (needs game data).

tasks.title: Replay corpus kept outside the repository
tasks.summary: Decide where replays come from (owner's games, GeneralsX's public replay repo) and how they are stored locally (`ZHWP_REPLAY_DIR`).

tasks.title: Cross-browser CRC matrix
tasks.summary: Phase 2 must show identical CRCs across browsers and OSes, but D-04 limits tests to Brave. Needs the owner's decision on which browsers to add.

tasks.title: D-06: network architecture for online play
tasks.summary: Lockstep over WebRTC data channels, signalling/relay server, where it is hosted and who pays. Decision record before any phase 3 code.

tasks.title: Signalling and relay server
tasks.summary: Small Node server: rooms, offer/answer/ICE exchange, relay fallback. Tested with synthetic clients.

tasks.title: Engine transport over WebRTC data channels
tasks.summary: Replace the UDP socket under `Transport` in the browser build with a JS bridge to data channels, keeping the engine's packet format.

tasks.title: Game lobby through the signalling server
tasks.summary: The engine's LAN lobby lists and joins games announced through the signalling server instead of UDP broadcast.

tasks.title: Two headless clients play a scripted match with identical CRCs
tasks.summary: Automated phase 3 check: two or more browsers play through the real network code; a desync fails and reports the first diverging frame.

tasks.title: Tag the last fidelity-only commit
tasks.summary: Tag and document the commit after which the original-replay oracle guards unchanged systems only.

tasks.title: Load content override archives after the originals
tasks.summary: The launcher imports a mod folder whose `.big` files load with higher priority, replacing originals one asset at a time.

tasks.title: Placeholder boxes for missing models
tasks.summary: A missing W3D model renders as a team-coloured box instead of failing.

tasks.title: Replays and tests for new content
tasks.summary: New content gets its own replays and CRC baselines, separate from the original-replay oracle.

tasks.title: Launcher: the storage estimate must warn, not refuse the import
tasks.check: cd web && npm ci && npx playwright test
tasks.summary: Brave reports a fixed storage quota, so #31's refusal blocked the real 2.1 GB import; turn it into a warning and report real write errors.

tasks.title: Launcher: import the local game folder automatically in development
tasks.check: cd web && npm ci && npx playwright test
tasks.summary: npm run serve exposes ZHWP_GAME_DIR read-only on 127.0.0.1 and the launcher imports it into OPFS on load; no manual folder pick on the owner's machine.

tasks.title: Flaky tests on main: launcher incomplete-folder and user-files #5
tasks.summary: Two existing tests fail intermittently on main (2/15 before #70, 7/15 after); kept for analysis.

tasks.title: WebGPU: render passes must get a depth-stencil format, not a colour texture
tasks.check: scripts/build-webgpu.sh && cd web && npm ci && npx playwright test tests/real-data-webgpu.spec.ts && env -u ZHWP_GAME_DIR npx playwright test
tasks.summary: Most frames are dropped because a 512x512 RGBA8 texture is bound as depth-stencil attachment: black canvas with flicker.

tasks.title: WebGPU: upload the small mip levels of compressed textures
tasks.check: scripts/build-webgpu.sh && cd web && npm ci && npx playwright test tests/real-data-textures.spec.ts && env -u ZHWP_GAME_DIR npx playwright test
tasks.summary: DXT mip levels under 4x4 fail WriteTexture validation; round copies up to whole blocks.

tasks.title: Browser build: fonts for the game's text
tasks.check: scripts/build-webgpu.sh && cd web && npm ci && npx playwright test tests/real-data-fonts.spec.ts && env -u ZHWP_GAME_DIR npx playwright test
tasks.summary: Preload the Liberation fonts already in assets/fonts into the browser build and map the game's faces to them, so in-game text renders.

tasks.title: Launcher: the game canvas fits the page
tasks.check: cd web && npm ci && npx playwright test
tasks.summary: The 1024x768 canvas overflows the launcher column; scale it to fit with its aspect ratio.
